sources.facts: Exact Helium Mobile, successor to Nano; 400 × 58 × 24 mm, about 125 g. Outer recess depths 14/22 mm, central 10/18 mm, top jug; back usable as jug/sloper. Supplied Beal 4 mm cord.
sources.notEstablished: No measured cross-section, recess widths, bore dimensions or wood species. No rear factory cross-section is published on this page.

sources.facts: Three separate rounded elongated front recesses in capsule silhouette. Labels establish lower 14/10/14 and opposing upper 22/18/22. Two front end cord openings. Rounded outer top.
sources.notEstablished: No reverse, no exact opening diameters or concealed passage routing. The brush and cord are contextual objects, not part of exported geometry.

conflicts.conflict: Manufacturer thickness 24 mm versus retailer 26 mm.
conflicts.ruling: Use current manufacturer 24 mm; retain 26 mm as conflicting secondary data, not an interchangeable revision.

conflicts.conflict: Nominal 22/14 mm versus one owner reporting 20/13 mm.
conflicts.ruling: Model explicit maker nominal dimensions, without claiming actual production tolerances. Do not silently change labels or scale from one unverified report.

conflicts.conflict: Earlier research treated the maker-described rear use as a missing separate groove, although the newly inspected HE6 rear crop shows a broad smooth face.
conflicts.ruling: Authorize one continuous rear face/roll contact using HE1 plus HE6. Do not invent an extra groove or count jug and sloper as separate physical contacts. Preserve uncertain rear ends and concealed routing as explicit limitations; the selected 125-degree X display rotation is authored, not a prescribed hanging position.
